HOW TO USE IT

Get the most from your protein

{{ first_name|default:'there' }}, a quick guide so your protein works as hard
as you do.

When: within two hours after training, or any time to hit your daily protein.
How: 1 scoop (about 25g protein) in 250–300ml cold water or milk; shake 15
seconds.
Daily: most active people need 1.6–2.2g of protein per kg of body weight, from
food first.

General guidance, not medical advice. Follow the label and speak to your
doctor if you have a medical condition.
